Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt-import-js/v/0.0.23
Exact package source: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2

Original package license and notices are retained in this directory:
  occt-import-js-LICENSE.txt
  occt-import-js-NOTICE-LICENSE.txt
  OpenCascade-NOTICE-LICENSE.txt

The packaged JavaScript and WASM asset are distributed at the pinned package
version. Before instantiation, PrintOps lowers the expected WASM memory section
maximum from 32768 to 4096 pages (256 MiB). Other sections are preserved. See
frontend/src/utils/wasmMemory.ts and its native growth regression in PrintOps.
The worker is terminated after 30 seconds and on preview cancellation.
